item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00151","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C23","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.8,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 plausibly supplied concrete Tariff Commission machinery reused in the child: Commission investigation, public notice and hearing, opportunity for interested parties to present evidence and be heard, findings and recommendations to the President, and Commission-prescribed procedures and regulations. C23 also closely reflects the child's trade-agreement process of public notice, receipt of interested views, and interagency/Tariff Commission advice, but it describes one completed agreement rather than laying out the same administrative machinery. C04 has a weaker parallel consultation-and-recommendation sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Tariff Commission... shall make an investigation... [and] shall report to the President its findings... The procedure and rules and regulations for the investigations by the Tariff Commission, and for the hearings... shall... be prescribed by the Commission.","parent_excerpt":"the United States Tariff Commission has made a supplemental investigation... the Commission has made findings of fact and has transmitted to me reports of such findings and its recommendations... The Tariff Commission is authorized to adopt such procedure and rules and regulations","explanation":"Both assign the Tariff Commission an investigation followed by findings or recommendations and authority over implementing procedures and regulations."},{"child_excerpt":"the Tariff Commission shall hold public hearings, giving reasonable public notice... and shall afford reasonable opportunity for parties interested to be present, to produce evidence, and to be heard","parent_excerpt":"after due notice, a public hearing was held... at which parties interested were given opportunity to be present, to produce evidence, and to be heard","explanation":"This is distinctive, nearly verbatim hearing language and supports literal drafting reuse."},{"child_excerpt":"Should the Tariff Commission find... that such injury is being caused or threatened, it shall recommend to the President... the withdrawal... or modification... to the extent and for such time... necessary to prevent such injury.","parent_excerpt":"the Commission has recommended that an additional quantity... be permitted entry... only to the extent that essential needs are found to exist","explanation":"Both use a Commission investigation and factual finding to support a tailored presidential import remedy, showing related substantive administrative structure."}]}
